summary: Deviation judged, no brief contradiction: refusal side effects are reported under L0.ok-exit and the report lists rule 8.2 for it (checker.md's L0 table lists 6.2, 6.4, 7.3.2, 7.3.3, 8.1). Brief F3 and checker.md 4 and 7.2 require a MUST failure naming the changed paths for an exit-2 call and the L0 table has no effects check, so ok-exit ('every invocation') is the owner; spec 8.2 states the rule. The report's rules column for that one check therefore differs from the approved table. Also judged and accepted: L0.unknown-option does not compare the process exit (checker.md 7.2 plants 'unknown option exits 1' as an L0.ok-exit-only failure, and the registered exit-2 code plus ok-exit together enforce exit 2) and L0.one-document reads only the plain probe --json run (the table scopes it to report or artifact commands; failure documents are read exactly by unknown-command).
